aṅgaṇa:
1aṅgaṇa
n. 2aṅgaṇa
n. [BHS id.], a speck of dirt; a blemish; a moral blemish, defilement; Abh 859 (kilese ca male cāṅgaṇaṃ); M I 24,.19 (ekacco puggalo sāṅgaṇo va samāno atthi me ajjhattaṃ ~an ti yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti); A V 92,.16 (puriso … sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno sace tattha passati rajaṃ vā ~aṃ vā tass’ eva rajassa vā ~assa vā pahānāya vāyamati; Mp V 41,.12 : ~an ti tatthajātaṃ aṅgakāḷatilakādi); Vibh 368,.8 (rāgo ~aṃ doso ~aṃ moho ~aṃ); Nett 88,.1 (~ā ca upakkilesā ca); Sp 157,.16 (~ena hi cittaṃ upakkilissati); Sadd 333,28* (rāgādisu kilesesu paṅke kāyamalamhi ca … ~aṃ); —      °-nāsana,   mfn., removing defilements; Utt-vn 1 (vanditvā … gaṇam ~aṃ); —      anaṅgaṇa,   mfn., free from blemish; spotless; Vin III 4,.18 (samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte ~e vigatūpakkilese; Sp 157,.16 : vihatarāgādi-aṅgaṇattā ~e, ~-ttā yeva vigatūpakkilese) ≠ D I 76,.14; Dhp 125 (suddhassa posassa ~assa); Sn 517 (vigatarajaṃ ~aṃ visuddhaṃ); Ja V 302,3* (mukhaṃ … subhaṃ sunettaṃ virajaṃ ~aṃ); Bv 8:10 (~ānaṃ virajānaṃ); —      niraṅgaṇa,   mfn., free from blemish, spotless; Bv-a 1,9* (namāmi … guṇākaraṃ c’ eva ~aṃ gaṇaṃ); 1,13*; —      saṅgaṇa,    sāṅgaṇa,   mfn., blemished; full of depravity; M I 24,.18; Sn 279 (dubbisodho hi ~o).
aṭṭhika:
1aṭṭhika
mfn. [= atthika1 qv; cf AMg aṭṭhiya], having a purpose or aim; having a desire or need for; Sp 877,.9 (aṭṭhikatvā ti °-bhāvaṃ katvā ~o hutvā ti, Ee so; Ce, Se atthiko; Be atthikabhāvaṃ … atthiko); Spk I 177,.26 (tāya desanāya ~ā hutvā, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se atthikā); II 198,.23 (aṭṭhikatvā ti attānaṃ tena dhammena ~am katvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee atthānatthena dhamme, prob. wr); — ifc see idam-.

2aṭṭhika
n. [aṭṭhi + ka2; S. asthika], 1. a bone; Vin II 115,.14 (~āni … pattena nīharanti); D II 344,.22 (sabbe so yakkho amanusso bhakkhesi ~ān’ eva sesesi); M III 92,.5 (~āni apagatasambandhāni); Cp 2:2:4 (nhārūhi ~ehi vā, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee nahāru-aṭṭhikehi); Mil 85,.11 (~āni dīghāni); Vism 264,.25 (~āni kaṭakaṭāyanti); Pv-a 212,.15 (kiṃ ~ānaṃ pūjanenā ti); — ifc see ūr’- (sv ūru), chav’-; — 2. a stone or seed (of a fruit); — ifc see amb’- (sv amba2), tāl’-; — aṭṭhikā in Ee at Pv-a 180,.19 is prob. wr; Be, Se aṭṭakā; Ce aṭṭikā; — aṭṭhikā in Ee at Ap 358,.13 is wr for addhikā (Be, Ce, Se so); —      °-saṅkhalikā,   f., a chain of bones, a skeleton; Vin III 105,.15 (addasaṃ ~aṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ); A III 324,.11 (passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ ~aṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ); Ja I 433,.17; Vism 192,.27 (sakalāya pi ~āya); —       °-saṅghāṭaka,   m. or n., a conjunction of bones, a skeleton; Sp 507,.12 (aṭṭhisaṅkhalikan ti setam nimmaṃsalohitaṃ ~aṃ, Ce, Ee so; Se °-saṅkhalikan ti … °-saṅghātaṃ; Be °-saṅkhalikan ti … aṭṭhisaṅghātaṃ); —       °-saññā,   f., the idea of bones, contemplation of the skeleton (as a meditation exercise); S V 129,.5 (Spk III 175,.22 : ~ā ti aṭṭhikaṃ aṭṭhikan ti bhāventassa uppannasaññā); A II 17,.3; Ja I 433,.16 (~ā uppajji, sakalaṃ pi taṃ sarīraṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikā viya paññāyi); Vism 112,.3.

3aṭṭhika
mfn. [aṭṭhi + ka2], having a stone or seeds; Sp 1102,.9 (cocapānan ti ~ehi kadaliphalehi katapānaṃ) = Nidd-a I 396,.18 (Be so; Se °-kadaliphalehi; Ce, Ee aṭṭhikadaliphalehi); — see also anaṭṭhika.
gādhati:
1gādhati
pr. 3 sg. [S. Dhātup gādhate, Wg § 2:3], 1. stands firm, has a firm footing; Dhātup 167 (gādha patiṭṭhāyaṃ); Dhātum 238; D I 223,7* (kattha āpo ca paṭhavī tejo vāyo na ~ati; Sv 392,.33 : na patiṭṭhāti) ≠ S I 15,16* = Ap 478,.24; S III 59,.30 (ye supaṭipannā te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ~anti); Ja III 499,23* (rāgo doso mado moho yattha paññā na ~ati); Sadd 394,.12 (gādha patiṭṭhānissayaganthesu: ~ati); — 2. strings together; Sadd 394,.12.

2gādhati
pr. 3 sg. [cf ogādha2 and S. gāhate], plunges into, enters;? Ja I 474,9* (candābhaṃ suriyābhaṃ ca yo ’dha paññāya ~ati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhāvati, prob. wr; or to gādhati1? 474,13´ : yo … idaṃ kasiṇadvayaṃ paññāya ~ati ārammaṇaṃ katvā anupavisati tattha vā patiṭṭhahati, Be, Se so; Ce bhāveti; Ee bhāvati) quoted Mp I 131,3* (131,.6 foll. : odātakasiṇaṃ candābhaṃ nāma pītakasiṇaṃ suriyābhaṃ nāmā ti taṃ ubhayaṃ yo paññāya ~ati pavisati pakkhandati …).
gāmī:

2gāmi(n)

(m.) a foot-soldier; (f.) infantry; Abh 359; 377 (padāti ~ī); 1012; Vin IV 105,.16 (senā nāma hatthī assā rathā ~ī); S I 102,24* (na tattha hatthīnaṃ bhūmi na rathānaṃ na ~iyā); Ja II 217,.5 (iminā niyāmena hatthī pesetha iminā asse iminā rathe iminā ~ī); IV 494,11* (hatthīhi assehi rathehi ~ihi parivāritā); VI 459,6* (hatthīnaṃ atha assānaṃ rathānaṃ atha ~inaṃ); Nidd I 126,.10 (rathaṃ passati ~iṃ passati); Mil 37,.20 (ettakā ~ī); 39,.28 (yathā mahārāja senā nānā santā hatthī ca assā ca rathā ca ~ī ca ekaṃ atthaṃ abhinipphādenti); Mhv 25:81; — pattīhi in Ee at Ja VI 459,9´ is wr for pantīhi (Be, Ce, Se so); —      ° ânīka, n., a body of infantry; Abh 383 (~aṃ catujjanā); Vin IV 107,.34 foll. 1patti(n)

(na bhikkhave hīnena aggassa ~i hoti aggena ca bhikkhave aggassa ~i hoti); It 10,4* (natth’ añño evaṃ bahukāro uttamatthassa ~iyā); Sn 425 (yogakkhemassa ~iyā); Th 69 (maggaṃ papajjiṃ amatassa ~iyā); Paṭis II 189,.35 (lābho paṭilābho ~i sampatti …); Dhs 277 (paṭhamāya bhūmiyā ~iyā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhummiyāpattiyā); Mil 263,.9 (sabbe te nippapañcassa ~iyā karonti); — ifc see janapadatthāvariya- (sv janapada), brahma- (sv brahma[n]); — 2. (te satamattā pi vāṇijā ekekaṃ sahassaṃ datvā tena saddhiṃ nāvāya pattikā hutvā puna ekekaṃ sahassaṃ datvā ~iṃ vissajjāpetvā bhaṇḍaṃ attano santakaṃ akaṃsu); — (ii) a share in the merit (of someone’s gift or action); the benefit (of someone else’s meritorious action); Ja II 423,.25 (bodhisatto atirekabhattaṃ gaṅgāya macchānaṃ datvā nadīdevatāya ~iṃ adāsi devatā ~iṃ anumoditvā yeva dibbena yasena vaḍḍhitvā …); IV 21,.10 (brāhmaṇo attanā katakalyāṇato tassa ~iṃ adāsi so anumodi); Vism 144,.2 (mayaṃ tumhaṃ ~iṃ katvā dhammaṃ sossāmā ti); Sv 999,.36 foll. (cattāro paccaye datvā sabbasattānaṃ ~i hotū ti …); Ps IV 234,.16 (eko kira amacco … mahācetiyaṃ pūjetvā Yamassa ~iṃ adāsi); Spk I 306,.3 (mayhaṃ mātāpitunnaṃ pi imasmiṃ sarabhaññe ~ī ti); Dhp-a I 104,.11 (rājā … mahādānaṃ datvā bhante ito tesaṃ petānaṃ dibbannapānaṃ sampajjatū ti ~iṃ adāsi); IV 122,.17 (~iṃ me dehī ti); 201,.9 (mūlaṃ vā ~iṃ vā dassāmī ti); As 158,.20 foll.; — see also apattika1; — 3. force, scope; — ifc see upayoga-, sampadānavacana- (sv sampadāna); — pattiyā in Ee, Se at Ap 214,.17 is prob. wr for sattiyā (Be, Ce so); —      °-dāna, n. [patti + dāna1], giving a share in one’s merit; giving the benefit (of a meritorious action); Ja II 426,1´ (imasmiṃ ṭhāne ~aṃ dakkhiṇā nāma jātaṃ); Vv-a 188,.21 (yaṃ mayā puññaṃ pasutaṃ taṃ anumodatha ~aṃ vo dammī ti); Saddh 229; —       °-patta, mfn. [patti + patta6], who has obtained what is to be obtained; who has reached the highest attainment; M I 386,21* (Ps III 98,.9 : ye pattabbā guṇā te pattassa); Khp 6:7; Sn 536 (Pj II 433,.24 : ~o ti pattabbaṃ patto … pattabbaṃ arahattaṃ patto ti vuttaṃ hoti); —       °-pattabbaka, mfn.who has attained what is to be attained;? Mhv 4:66 (Mhv-ṭ 170,.11 foll.: pāpuṇitabbaṃ adhigantabbavisesadhammaṃ pattaṃ paṭiladdhaṃ yesaṃ te ~ā, tesaṃ ~ānaṃ sampattapattabbakānan ti attho … katakaranīyānan ti adhippāyo); —     appatti, f., the failure to obtain; the not attaining; Vism 505,.12 (tesaṃ ~-paccupaṭṭhānā); — see also kiṃpatti(n) (sv ka3), apunabhavappattika (sv puna(b)bhava).
